missing_values: Empty CSV cells mean unavailable or not applicable, never a measured zero.

files.runs.csv: One row per forward inference run, shared by all questions.
files.query_results.csv: One row per fixed question for completed runs; no query rows for failed runs.
files.task_trace.csv: One row per selected task, with variable names normalized within each term.

definitions.status: completed, error, or timeout. A completed run may have unanswered questions.
definitions.answer_found: The final belief buffer yields an answer using PeTTa's ConfidenceRank selector, including its strict > comparison against zero confidence.
definitions.verified_answer_status: unknown until a separate independent answer check is available; regression agreement is not scientific correctness.
definitions.selected_task_count: Count of consecutive SELECTED records between exactly one BEGIN and END pair.
definitions.pln_elapsed_ms: PeTTa current-time difference around the unmodified PLN.Derive call. Wall clock, includes SELECTED tracing; excludes imports and final-state/query printing.
definitions.total_elapsed_ms: Monotonic parent-process wall time around process launch, wait and result parsing. Includes PeTTa startup, compilation, imports, tracing and query evaluation; excludes settings hashing and final CSV writing. Not pure inference time.
definitions.relevant_facts_selected: Distinct annotated evidence IDs appearing in selected tasks; derived tasks may carry several IDs. Not a measure of all premises used as paired beliefs.
definitions.relevant_facts_in_answer: Distinct annotated IDs present in the returned answer's evidence stamp.
definitions.relevant_facts_available: Size of an annotated sufficient evidence path, not an exhaustive list of every possible path. Blank if no path is known.
definitions.stop_reason: task_queue_empty if no tasks remain, otherwise step_limit.

limits: PeTTa LimitSize trims until length < configured limit. Initial queues are not pre-trimmed. Input ordering is preserved.
